title: Perfetti Method in Upper Extremity of Stroke Patients
brief_summary: The cognitive sensory motor training therapy (Perfetti's technique) might be more effectiveness than conventional occupational therapy on upper extremity function recovery after acute stroke patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* First ever stroke
* Impaired upper extremity function
* Given signed inform consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unstable medical condition
* Any upper extremity functional impairment prior to stroke
* Can not adequately cooperate in training
* Severe communication problems
* Severe cognitive - perceptual deficits
* Fixed contracture more than 30 degree in every upper extremity joint
